drift_findings.finding: SHORT_RSI_FLOOR bypass when live RSI unavailable
drift_findings.detail: _ctx_gate_get_rsi() returns None when <15 1m candles available. When None, SHORT_RSI_FLOOR check is skipped entirely (line 1001: if _live_rsi_floor is not None). COMP RSI=13.04, DOT RSI=27.27 at detection — both executed despite being below floor. Trades lost -$0.14 and -$0.32 respectively.
drift_findings.affected_trades: COMP SHORT -$0.14, DOT SHORT -$0.32 (both EXTREME regime)
drift_findings.fix: Add detection-time RSI check: if (_signal_metadata->rsi_14) < SHORT_RSI_FLOOR, block even if live RSI is None

drift_findings.finding: Chase filter only covers LONG direction
drift_findings.detail: CHASE_FILTER at line 4130: direction.upper() == LONG. SHORT chasing not blocked. Not currently a major issue since SHORT entries are less prone to chasing.
drift_findings.impact: Minimal — SHORT chasing is less common
